candidate.title: Some OAuth integrations refresh via refreshOAuthTokens but persist the raw sync response without parseRefreshTokenResponse normalization
reports: [advisory] lark, msteams (office365video) and webex route refreshes through refreshoauthtokens but never apply parserefreshtokenresponse, so the sync endpoint's response is consumed through legacy error handlers with no schema validation and no refreshtoken placeholder injection. a sync response missing app-specific fields (e.g. lark's refreshtoken/expire, webex's expiresin) is persisted verbatim into credential.key, silently degrading those integrations in sync mode.

[advisory] hubspot and lark call sites route their refresh through refreshoauthtokens but do not apply parserefreshtokenresponse, while google, zoom, office365 and salesforce do — the refactor's coverage is inconsistent across apps for the same stated feature. in sync mode hubspot/lark receive whatever shape the sync endpoint returns with no validation at all (minimum or otherwise), so a misconfigured sync endpoint corrupts hubspot/lark credentials silently while the same misconfiguration is caught (loudly) for the other apps; the next maintainer must reverse-engineer which apps got which half of the feature.
